qa: No, you can't. This card is only treated as [Starmons] for a DigiXros. Related Cards

text_sections.label: Effect
text_sections.text: This card is also treated as [Starmons] for DigiXros. [All Turns] [Once Per Turn] When any of your [Xros Heart] trait Digimon are played, until the end of your opponent's turn, give 1 of their Digimon ＜Security A. -1＞ and it gets -3000 DP. [On Deletion] You may place 1 Digimon card with the [Xros Heart] or [Blue Flare] trait from your hand or trash under any of your Tamers.

text_sections.label: Inherited Effect
text_sections.text: [When Attacking] [Once Per Turn] If this Digimon has the [Xros Heart] trait, 1 of your opponent's Digimon gets -2000 DP for the turn.
